overview: The committee reviewed the parking department's surveillance technology policies, the status of the Green Line Extension parking zone, and proposed changes to City Hall parking regulations.

items.title: Parking Department Surveillance Reporting
items.summary: Placed on file the surveillance impact report and use policy for automatic license plate readers, pending amendments regarding data retention and sharing restrictions.

items.title: Green Line Extension (G-Zone) Parking Program
items.summary: Requested that the administration issue updated public communications clarifying that the G-Zone parking program is now permanent and restricted to Medford residents.

items.title: City Hall Parking Ordinance Amendment
items.summary: Reported out of committee a proposed repeal of section 78-173 to designate the lot directly behind City Hall for municipal employee use only during business hours.

items.title: Parking Ticket Appeals Process
items.summary: Discussed the transparency of the parking ticket appeals process and recent technical fixes made to the digital evidence upload system.
